title: batch-report-job never finishes -- telemetry-agent is eating its CPU share
description_md:
`batch-report-job` (the nightly report roll-up) has been running for ages and barely making progress. The box's own runbook is explicit that `telemetry-agent` (a background metrics scraper) must always run deprioritized so it never competes evenly with real work -- but on this box, `batch-report-job` is getting almost no more CPU time than `telemetry-agent` is, despite `telemetry-agent` being the lower-importance job. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), work out what's actually competing for the CPU, and correct its priority so the important job gets its fair share.

You're done when `batch-report-job` is clearly getting the lion's share of CPU time again.
